briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate compute arms race as multi-agent systems hit production

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with new model releases and massive infrastructure bets. Regulatory pressure mounts amid rising security incidents. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in enterprise pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; xAI debuts Grok-4; DeepSeek releases 671B open model. Anthropic's Claude 4 focuses on constitutional alignment upgrades.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across automotive and BCI domains.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce 200k H100-equivalent cluster expansions. TSMC begins volume production of 1.6nm AI chips for custom accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards emerge before a major cross-model exploit cascades globally?
